info.title: PiPer Direct C position-control API
info.description: Loopback-only C/SocketCAN controller. No Python or robot SDK. Read /api/state for the per-process token, stable selected device_id and current connection generation. Every POST requires X-Piper-Token and application/json. Accepted actions are asynchronous: poll state and renew the matching owner/request_id lease every 200 ms. Lease expires at 800 ms. Commands never resume automatically after reconnect or restart. A single-joint command sends a six-angle MoveJ pose, holding other joints at their initial measured positions. This API does not bypass the onboard MCU or expose raw torque/MIT/calibration/firmware writes. State includes controller teach_state, fault masks, persisted last_fault and per-joint max_acceleration_rad_s2/acceleration_fresh/acceleration_age_s. New motion and enable require valid angle, speed and acceleration limits read on this connection. Static configuration remains valid while the connection is uninterrupted; there is no periodic refresh or 60-second expiry. USB/CAN reconnection, a robot status-stream gap or an explicit information query invalidates the cache. Live position, motor and fault feedback still use the normal short freshness checks. Acceleration limits must be finite, greater than zero and at most 5 rad/s². Queries are read-only and preserve unresolved recovery locks. The limits_fresh, acceleration_fresh and gripper configuration_fresh fields mean valid for this connection; their age fields report elapsed time without imposing an expiry. Missing optional standard CAN gripper settings do not block the arm or Pika.

post.summary: Start or stop the configured local bench webcam
post.description: Independent of robot motion. Simulation never opens a real webcam. No microphone or recording.

200.description: Camera state; capture start is asynchronous

get.summary: Read the latest fresh bench-camera JPEG

200.description: JPEG received within the last 1.5 seconds

get.summary: Discover adapters and read feedback, diagnostics, control status and token

200.description: Unknown numeric measurements are null. fresh/age_s describe validity. tx_frames counts queued, not acknowledged, frames. motion exposes active, owner, request_id, speed_deg_s, tolerance_deg and elapsed_s. devices contain stable ID, generation, interface, firmware, hardware, status, recovery gate, six joints and gripper feedback.

post.summary: Select a discovered stable adapter; no motor command
Request firmware, then six limits; ends within 3 seconds
post.description: Queues one firmware read. Limit queries follow only after external robot data is received. Missing replies stay unknown.

post.summary: Reopen CAN sockets and refresh selected arm firmware/limits; no network configuration or motion
post.description: Invalidates cached feedback, then starts one bounded information query on the selected adapter if its CAN socket is available. Motion and stop recovery remain explicit. Poll query_active for completion; 200 does not guarantee robot replies.

200.description: Sockets reopened; selected adapter information read started if available

post.summary: Control joints, a pose, motor power, gripper or recovery
post.description: enable requires all six drivers disabled and supported=true. joint sets one absolute degree target; jog adds a signed increment to the current measured angle; zero sets one target to 0 degrees without calibration writes. pose takes six absolute angles; synchronized=true uses one shared interpolation fraction so joints follow the planned straight line in joint space. gripper sets opening from 0 to the freshly queried hardware maximum (70 or 100 mm), at 5 mm/s and effort_nm 0.02–0.5 N·m (default 0.1). If raw closed feedback is between −2 and 0 mm, allow_closed_offset=true permits an explicit opening to at least 5 mm with a bounded 1 mm entry target; no encoder calibration is changed. Configuration is checked throughout motion. disable/reset require physical support, known firmware and fresh status. reset powers motors off, sends once and verifies fresh disabled, stationary feedback. A pending reset cannot be resent. verify-reset requires reset_completed=true after an operator reset/power cycle. hold is accepted from the owner during an active joint/pose move or gripper ramp. For a gripper it ends the ramp while retaining the last sent target and effort; it does not certify contact or a secure grasp. New moves require a stationary arm and fresh limits. All asynchronous actions require heartbeats. Enable transmits only driver power commands, without a position target or mode change. align explicitly moves resting joints at most 3 degrees to 0.5 degrees inside their command ranges, at 1% MCU speed, retaining all other targets. Larger corrections are rejected. verify-disabled clears a recovery record without CAN transmission only when all drivers are healthy, stationary and disabled; pending resets still require verify-reset. A successful normal disable clears only its own in-flight record; earlier stops remain latched. cycle requires enabled motors and a starting pose within limits. It captures that measured pose, raises toward [start J1,82,-160,0,-7,start J6] degrees, pauses for two seconds after verified arrival, and returns to the captured pose. Cycle speed is fixed at up to 3 degrees/second with 0.2-degree feedback tolerance; it uses synchronized joint interpolation and a 180-second deadline. Stop, Hold, lease loss, faults or disconnection cancel the remaining cycle; return is never automatic after interruption. Motion remains supervised by the existing heartbeat. motion.sequence_stage is raising/upright/returning while active; motion.return_degrees contains the captured pose.

202.description: Accepted; retain request_id, renew heartbeat, then check measured completion

400.description: Invalid input, missing operator acknowledgement or target outside limits

409.description: Feedback, mode, firmware, driver, lease, connection or recovery prerequisite failed

500.description: Persistent intent could not be saved; no action started

409.description: No matching active lease or already expired

post.summary: Best-effort software stop on selected arm; persist recovery requirement
post.description: Does not require motion health checks or matching owner. Fast stop can allow damped descent; it is not a power cut or guaranteed hold. Active gripper motion also gets a gripper disable request. Disconnected hardware cannot receive the stop. Inspect physical state before recovery.

200.description: Stop attempted; read message and physical state

device_id.description: Stable USB adapter identity returned by state

generation.description: Changes when the CAN socket reconnects

standalone.description: Operator confirms no linked leader or competing controller

clear.description: Operator confirms full path clear and attended; required for enable/moves

supported.description: Operator confirms physical support; required for power/recovery

degrees.description: Absolute degrees for joint/pose; delta for jog (±5 max). Controller-reported joint limits always apply.

speed_percent.description: Percentage of the slowest fresh reported joint speed limit. Mutually exclusive with legacy speed_deg_s. Zero blocks new joint moves; it does not stop an active move. Alignment and scripted cycle retain explicit rates.
